title: Advanced Find-and-Modify Operations — practice

objective: Apply advanced find-and-modify operations and verify its result safely.

options: Disable access controls and embed connection credentials in source code to avoid configuration work.
Assume the reference output guarantees behavior across all MongoDB versions and deployment types.

expected_output: Use a selective filter and the narrowest update operator that expresses the intended change; verify matched/modified counts and test an idempotent retry where applicable.

grading_config.correct_answer: Use a selective filter and the narrowest update operator that expresses the intended change; verify matched/modified counts and test an idempotent retry where applicable.
